title: Nauru taps Bitcoiner Dadvan Yousuf for trade role in digital asset push
summary: Nauru moves from building rules to promoting its digital asset framework as it looks to attract companies and cross-border partnerships.

title: Bitcoin ETFs clock $291M outflows as BTC blasts past $74K
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $291 million in outflows on Monday as BTC climbed above $74,000, marking the biggest day of redemptions since March 27, led by FBTC.

title: Web3 hacks cost $482M in Q1 as phishing drives majority of losses: Hacken
summary: Hacken’s Q1 2026 report finds $482 million lost across 44 incidents, with phishing, legacy code bugs and key compromises driving losses as regulators tighten security demands.

title: UK Lib Dems call for probe into Farage over $2.7M Stack BTC promotion
summary: UK Liberal Democrats called on the FCA to examine Nigel Farage’s Stack BTC promotion as scrutiny grows over crypto conflicts and political donations.

title: US Justice Department opens compensation for victims of $4B OneCoin crypto fraud
summary: OneCoin was launched by Ruja Ignatova and Karl Sebastian Greenwood in Bulgaria. Ignatova has been missing since 2017, and Greenwood was sentenced to 20 years in prison.

title: Bitcoin bears eye $50K bottom as analysts claim final flush still to come
summary: Bitcoin falling to the $50,000 level is being seen as the “last significant accumulation zone” before any sustained recovery, says LVRG Research director Nick Ruck.

title: Banks challenge White House report on stablecoin yields
summary: The American Bankers Association is concerned that stablecoin yields would lead to mass deposit outflows from smaller community banks.

title: Former CFTC Chair Giancarlo leaves law to focus on crypto advisory
summary: Chris Giancarlo, who oversaw the first Bitcoin futures ETF approval as CFTC chairman, will now advise fintech and digital asset founders and boards.

title: Bitcoin nears $75K as Iran deal hopes spark $400M short squeeze
summary: A broad hope for a US deal with Iran to end weeks of conflict has spurred investor confidence in riskier assets.

title: South Korea fines Coinone $3.5M, orders partial business suspension: Reports
summary: Coinone is the second to face South Korea’s crackdown on exchanges in the last month, following a $24 million fine and a six-month partial suspension order against Bithumb.
